reviewers.summary: Re-review after the incomplete-escaping rejection. Chunk 1/4: namespace-to-subject call sites use the shared safe_subject_segment encoder; None/empty handling delegated to the shared encoder default. Chunk 2/4: the encoder now keeps only [A-Za-z0-9-] verbatim, maps '.' -> '_' and percent-encodes every other character per UTF-8 byte, so '@','#','$','/',':','%','_','*','>', whitespace and non-ASCII can no longer leak into a subject, while the a.b / a_b collision stays fixed and the legacy alice.ns -> alice_ns shape is preserved. Chunk 3/4: new tests assert single-token validity, an allowed-character set, injectivity across percent-lookalike pairs and exact encodings. Chunk 4/4: collision and stub/restore assertions sound; no defect established.
